headline: NORTHWEST COPPER DRILLS 108.7M AT 2.53% CUEQ IN KWANIKA WESTERN ZONE — B.C. PORPHYRY EXTENDS BEYOND KNOWN RESOURCE
snippet: NorthWest Copper (TSXV: NWST) reported hole K-26-263 at its 100%-owned Kwanika project in British Columbia intersected 108.7 metres grading 0.70% copper and 1.69 g/t gold (2.53% copper equivalent) from 352.8 metres depth in the Western Zone — a sector previously characterised by lower-grade mineralization. The intercept extends confirmed high-grade continuity into an underdrilled portion of Kwanika, building on 2025 program results that had already flagged the Western Zone as one of the deposit's most significant near-term expansion targets ahead of an anticipated resource update.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER DRILLS 307.5 G/T AGEQUIV OVER 21.2M AT ALASKA'S PALMER — Q1 2027 RESOURCE UPDATE TARGETED
source_name: The Northern Miner / Vizsla Copper (TSXV: VCU)
snippet: Vizsla Copper (TSXV: VCU) released results from holes CMR26-215 and CMR26-211 at the AG Deposit of its Palmer polymetallic project in Southeast Alaska, with CMR26-215 returning 21.2 metres at 307.5 g/t silver equivalent (9.67% zinc equivalent), including 7.2 metres at 438.0 g/t AgEq, from 180.3 metres depth. All three holes from the 2026 AG infill campaign are now complete, and the company plans to integrate the data into an updated mineral resource estimate targeted for Q1 2027 — with assays from 15 additional holes across Palmer's HG and South Wall zones still expected through mid-November.

headline: ALTIUS MINERALS BIDS FOR REST OF TNR GOLD AMID BOARD FIGHT — TARGETING ARGENTINE COPPER-LITHIUM ROYALTIES
source_name: The Northern Miner / Altius Minerals (TSX: ALS)
snippet: Altius Minerals (TSX: ALS) filed an unsolicited, non-binding proposal to acquire the roughly 87% of TNR Gold it doesn't already own, with TNR's special committee granting exclusivity for the evaluation. Financial terms were not disclosed; at TNR's pre-announcement price of 32¢ the company was valued at approximately $78M. The strategic rationale is Altius gaining exposure to TNR's royalty portfolio over two major Argentine copper and lithium projects — the bid arriving mid-dispute, with New York-based activist Eucalyptus Resources having just agreed to stand down its proxy fight pending the strategic review.

headline: PROSPECTOR METALS LOGS 130.77 G/T GOLD OVER 2.25M IN YUKON TESS ZONE — 84 HOLES STILL PENDING ASSAY
snippet: Prospector Metals (TSXV: PPP) reported hole ML26-056 at its ML Gold Project in Yukon's Tintina Gold Belt returned 41.34 g/t gold over 7.81 metres, including a bonanza-grade sub-interval of 130.77 g/t over 2.25 metres in the Tess Zone. With 84 holes from the 2026 multi-rig campaign still awaiting assay, the distribution of outcomes remains wide — but this early result preserves the high-grade profile that has defined the Tess Zone since the project's 2025 maiden drill program and positions ML for a substantial resource update once the full season's data is in.

headline: STRIKEPOINT GOLD CLOSES NORTHUMBERLAND FROM NEWMONT — 2.86M OZ AU RESOURCE IN NEVADA'S WALKER LANE
source_name: The Deep Dive / StrikePoint Gold (TSXV: SKP)
snippet: StrikePoint Gold (TSXV: SKP) completed its acquisition of the Northumberland gold project in Nevada's Walker Lane from Newmont Corporation, paying US$70 million upfront (two contingent payments of US$25 million each tied to feasibility and production milestones remain outstanding), backed by a C$190 million subscription receipt financing closed in September. The deal hands StrikePoint a resource of 2.86 million ounces gold equivalent indicated and 1.57 million ounces inferred — a multi-million-ounce Nevada asset acquired from a major that positions the company as one of the more substantive Walker Lane juniors heading into 2027 drilling.

headline: NOVAGOLD Q3: $343M CASH, DONLIN 100% CONSOLIDATION ON TRACK — 39M OZ ALASKA DEPOSIT ADVANCES TOWARD BFS
snippet: NovaGold's third-quarter 2026 report filed October 8 shows $343.4 million in cash and term deposits — providing runway well past the 2027 Bankable Feasibility Study target — as the all-share transaction to acquire Paulson & Co's 40% stake in Donlin Gold LLC (announced July 22) moves toward completion and would make NovaGold sole owner of the approximately 39-million-ounce Alaska deposit. Endeavour Financial and Macquarie Capital are in place as financial advisors to arrange project and infrastructure financing, and permitting proceedings continue at the Alaska Supreme Court level.

headline: ARMSTRONG ECONOMICS OCT 8: GOLD CONSOLIDATES AT $4,110-$4,170 SUPPORT — FED RATE FEARS WEIGH ON MINERS
snippet: Martin Armstrong's October 8 Market Talk frames gold's current $4,110-$4,170 consolidation band as a technically important zone after the metal's 25%+ decline from January 2026's all-time peak near $5,600, with Fed rate expectations re-emerging as a near-term headwind as energy-driven inflation data softens the pivot narrative. Armstrong places the $4,000 level as the key structural support to watch: a sustained break below it would technically challenge the longer-term bull case, while a hold sets up a potential re-test of the $4,300-$4,400 resistance zone heading into Q4.

headline: GOLDSTOCK CANADA: ENERGY INFLATION BETS WEIGH ON GOLD OCT 8 — PRECIOUS METALS RETREAT AS FED PIVOT BETS FADE
snippet: Gold Stock Canada's October 8 post-market summary attributes Wednesday's gold and silver weakness to energy-driven inflation data reigniting bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes, reversing the previous session's China Golden Week demand rebound in precious metals. The note, citing Bloomberg, describes the price action as consistent with a market still digesting the gap between gold's January 2026 peak and current levels near $4,150 — with the inability to reclaim $4,200 on Tuesday's bounce leaving short-term momentum traders cautious heading into the weekend.
